conditions: over 475 cal AND under 35 g carbs per serving; scalable to 14; no seafood; low-carb calorie-dense (no starch base) preferred
notes: All 9 verified from the source page own published nutrition. Cuisine spread is inherently narrow for low-carb calorie-dense beef; two whole-muscle dishes (shaved steak, brisket) and varied methods included. Per the pricer-lane exercise, unmapped signature ingredients were KEPT and flagged.

candidates.name: Low-Carb Bacon Cheeseburger Casserole
candidates.why: Big margin (631 cal / 4 g carbs / 32 g protein). Crustless egg-and-beef bake, every ingredient maps to the board. Weigh-and-divide from a scaled pan is trivial at 14.

candidates.name: Zucchini Lasagna with Ground Beef (No Noodles)
ingredients: 6 provolone slices (or 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese)
unmapped: provolone slices (garnish layer; recipe gives shredded-mozzarella alternative which maps to shredded-cheese)
candidates.why: Clears at 499 cal / 11 g carbs / 33 g protein with zucchini standing in for noodles - a genuinely low-carb lasagna, distinct from catalog moussaka (eggplant) and pastitsio (pasta).

candidates.name: Big Mac Salad (Cheeseburger in a Bowl)
unmapped: French dressing (recipe gives ketchup alternative which maps to the board)
candidates.why: 548 cal / 16 g carbs / 25 g protein - deconstructed cheeseburger, no bun. Fatty-mayo special sauce is the calorie engine. Distinct from catalog cheeseburger-rice-bowls. Some cheese/sauce quantities are unquantified on the page.

candidates.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Soup (Low Carb)
ingredients: 6 small slices of thin cut streaky bacon, chopped (90g)
1.5 cup shredded cheddar or monterey jack cheese (170g)
candidates.why: 605 cal / 4.9 g carbs / 32 g protein, every ingredient on the board. No cheeseburger soup in the 138-recipe beef catalog. Soup pot scales to 14 without fuss.

candidates.name: Keto Beef Meatloaf
unmapped: pork rinds (binder; no board home - a genuine pricer-lane test, or substitutes to bread-crumbs on board)
candidates.why: 512 cal / 6 g carbs / 49 g protein - pork-rind binder instead of breadcrumbs keeps it low-carb. No meatloaf in the beef catalog. Bakes as loaves or a sheet-pan slab.

candidates.name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
unmapped: shaved beef steak (no exact board home; sirloin-steak/ribeye-steak exist and recipe says ground beef works fine)
candidates.why: 535 cal / 9 g carbs / 28 g protein. Peppers-as-vessel, no starch. Distinct format from catalog philly-cheesesteak-skillet-bowls (rice). Two unmapped items make it a deliberate pricer-lane probe. Scales to 7 peppers = 14 halves.

candidates.name: Keto Taco Casserole (No Chips)
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil or avocado oil
candidates.why: 519 cal / 5 g carbs / 27 g protein, all mapped. Egg-and-cream-bound bake, no tortilla or chip base - structurally distinct from catalog loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls (skillet + rice).

candidates.name: Loaded Cauliflower and Beef Casserole
unmapped: fresh chives (garnish only; no board home)
candidates.why: 522 cal / 5 g carbs / 29 g protein. Cauliflower base (frozen-cauliflower-florets on board) keeps it dense but low-carb. Overlaps the cheeseburger-casserole family but the cauliflower + bacon build is a distinct dish.

candidates.name: Slow-Roasted Beef Brisket (Keto Dry Rub)
unmapped: fresh beef brisket (board only carries corned-beef-brisket, not a raw brisket cut - a strong pricer-lane test)
brown Swerve (keto sweetener; no board home - drop or sub brown-sugar)
candidates.why: 567 cal / 5.1 g carbs / 82 g protein - a spice-rubbed whole-muscle roast, structurally low-carb (meat + rub). Only whole-brisket dish in the lane; the raw-brisket cut is genuinely absent from the board, exactly the pricer-lane feature this run wants.
